title: Density Conversion
text: Convert from density units to desired density units, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial unit} sets Input units; {Final unit} sets the output units. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial unit
params.values: Input units lbm/ft^3 (default) | kg/m^3 | slug/ft^3 | lbm/in^3

params.name: Final unit
params.values: Output units kg/m^3 (default) | lbm/ft^3 | slug/ft^3 | lbm/in^3
